## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green (backend tests, frontend tests, security scans).
- [ ] New/changed behavior is covered by tests.
- [ ] API contracts, frontend types and tests are aligned (if applicable).
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or `.env` values are committed.
- [ ] Docs (`README`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/`) updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] Changes are focused and reasonably small.
